newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon H1 oper profit up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon H1 oper profit up 10 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Full name of the German carbon and graphite manufacturer is SGL Carbon AG.
Group DVFA earnings per share 4.65 dmk vs n/a
NOTE - SGL gave the following results for the second quarter of 1997:
Three months to June 30 (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group DVFA earnings per share 2.64 dmk vs 2.38 dmk
The company also said its order books made it confident for the second half of 1997 due to "very good" capacity utilisation in the carbon and graphite division.
SGL said in a mandatory statement that it was maintaining its upbeat forecast for the full year.
